title: Time clock
subtitle: Clock communication — sync, diagnosis, employees and settings.
onlyAdmin: Only ADMIN can talk to the time clock.
busyBanner: A clock operation is already running. Please wait.
busy: A clock operation is already in progress. Try again shortly.
failed: Failed to run the clock command.

orgShortcut.title: Advanced setup (Organization)
orgShortcut.desc: CNPJ, policies and company data live under Organization → System.

diagnosis.title: Device diagnosis
diagnosis.hint: Read-only — these actions do not change the clock.
diagnosis.hintFriendly: Use this screen to check whether the clock is responding, the employer data is correct, and basic features (card, keyboard, capacity) are active. If a sync operation fails, test here what is offline.
diagnosis.empty: Run a read to see device data.
diagnosis.emptyFriendly: Click “Test everything” to read status, identity and employer from the clock.
diagnosis.notReadYet: Not read in this session yet.

errors.protocolUnsupported: This PrintPoint does not report firmware/MAC over this protocol — connection is fine (serial was read). Punch collection is not blocked.
errors.timeout: The clock did not respond in time. Check power, cable/network and IP.
errors.connection: Could not connect to the clock. Check network/IP and that the device is on.
errors.busy: The clock is busy with another operation. Try again shortly.

idle.title: No test in this session
idle.body: Run “Test everything” to see if the clock is online and answering RH.

ok.title: Clock responding normally
ok.body: Reads completed. If punch collection still fails, the issue is usually the sync service on the server — not the device.

warn.title: Partial response or warnings
warn.body: The clock answered, but some reads were incomplete or returned errors. Check the cards below.

error.title: Failed to talk to the clock
error.body: One or more reads failed. Check PrintPoint power/network, cable/IP, and that dmprep-sync is running on the server.

employees.title: Employees on the clock
employees.hint: Compares RH records (PIS) with the list read from the device.
employees.name: Name
employees.bioRhSourceHint: The biometric column uses the confirmation from the employee record in HR (not the device fingerprint inventory).
employees.confirmSend: Send the selected employees to the clock?
employees.confirmRemove: Permanently remove the selected PIS from the clock? This does not delete the RH record.
employees.confirmExcludeFp: Exclude the fingerprint for the selected PIS on the clock?
employees.confirmExcludeOrphans: Exclude all fingerprints without a matching employee on the clock?
employees.empty: No results. Load the clock lists first.
employees.fingerprintUnsupported: Fingerprint read is not supported on this device — use the confirmation on the RH employee record.

datetime.title: Date, time and display
datetime.holidaysHint: One ISO date per line (YYYY-MM-DD or full ISO). You can load organization holidays.

settings.title: Clock settings
settings.warning: Sensitive changes may interrupt communication or punch recording. Use with care.
settings.netWarning: Changing IP/mask/gateway/DNS may make the clock unreachable on this network.
settings.employerWarning: Changing the employer on the REP is sensitive and audited. Confirm the data before sending.

audit.title: Command audit
audit.hint: Recent clock commands for this organization.
audit.loadFailed: Failed to load the command log.
